name: singular-composer
description: Control Singular Composer with packaged CLI helpers and Playwright dependencies.

interface.shortDescription: Create and verify Composer graphics without npm setup.
interface.longDescription: Inspect and author graphics in an authorized Singular Composer editor, manage composition scripts, and verify output in the Player. Includes pinned JavaScript dependencies and Playwright Core. Requires Node.js 22+ and installed Google Chrome for standalone capture and Player verification.
defaultPrompt: Connect to my open Singular Composer composition.
Create a lower third in Singular Composer.
